scenarios.title: Trail Camera Setup
scenarios.text: Sprinkle 3 oz of scent beads directly in front of your trail camera. Apply liquid scent to the nearest brush or branch and let the wind kick-start the area. The 30-day bead release means your camera captures a full month of game activity from a single visit — no need to revisit the site to refresh bait or scent.

scenarios.title: Tree Stand / Ground Blind Hunting
scenarios.text: Deploy beads in your target area. Apply liquid scent to trees along the expected approach route to create a scent trail guiding deer to the bead site. Add Earth Cover Scent beads in a 10-foot radius around your stand to mask your own odor.

scenarios.title: Mock Scrape Creation
scenarios.text: Find an overhanging limb 4–5 feet off the ground. Clear leaves to bare soil. Sprinkle 1–2 oz of Scrape Blend scent beads. Apply Scrape Blend or Dominant Buck liquid to the licking branch. The beads maintain attraction for 30 days.

scenarios.title: Bear Bait Site Enhancement
scenarios.text: Scatter 3–4 oz of sweet-scent beads around the bait container. Apply Anise, Berry, or Persimmon liquid on trees and logs within 20 yards.

scenarios.title: Feral Hogs
scenarios.text: Scatter Pear, Blackstrap Molasses, or Peanut Butter beads inside and around trap perimeters or known rooting areas.

questions.q: What is the best strategy for selecting which scent(s) to use?
questions.a: Use a tight-patterned shotgun, not a rifle – meaning, there may be a combination of attractants used to bring the best results. Bucks are actively seeking receptive does across an entire 10–14-day peak rut, so maintaining scent presence throughout that period maximizes your chances. Deploy doe estrus beads to release scent consistently over days or weeks rather than trying to time a single "magic window." This is exactly why Odin's 30-day beads outperform single-application products—you're covering the full window, not guessing at one day.

questions.q: Are Odin's products safe around children and pets?
questions.a: Yes. Odin's products are non-toxic and contain no animal-derived ingredients. However, they are not intended for consumption. Store products out of reach of children and pets, as with any household product.

questions.q: What makes Odin's different from other scent products?
questions.a: Three key differences: (1) Duration — Odin's beads last 30 days vs. 24-36 hours for liquids that will soak into the ground. (2) Weather resistance — the polymer bead system is unaffected by rain, snow, or temperature changes. (3) Consistency — synthetic formulations deliver the same scent concentration every time, unlike natural products that vary with every batch.

questions.q: How can I attract deer to a specific spot without using food bait?
questions.a: Use Odin's lure scent beads the same way as if you were using actual food. You want to attract deer to a specific spot at which you are confident in making an ethical kill shot. Put down a 3-oz bottle of Odin's beads where you want the deer to stop. To create pattering, you can put just a few beads in a trail to lead them or squirt liquid on foliage along the trail.

questions.q: Are there any special storage requirements for Odin's products?
questions.a: No. No refrigeration, no cooler, no special conditions. There's nothing natural in the product that can initiate bacterial growth, spoil, or convert to ammonia. Store it in your garage, shed, or truck—wherever is convenient. If the beads aren't exposed to air, no scent is released and they stay as strong as the day they were made.

questions.q: How should I store unused scent products?
questions.a: Keep sealed bottles at room temperature in a dry location. The synthetic formula provides a multi-year shelf life with no degradation. No refrigeration is required, unlike natural urine products that degrade rapidly.

Yes. Odin's scent beads are made from a plant-based biodegradable polymer that breaks down completely when left on the ground. How long it takes depends on environmental conditions—a good reference point is the time it takes for a banana peel to degrade.

questions.q: How many scent beads should I use per application?
questions.a: For standard deployment at a trail camera or stand site, use approximately 3 oz (smaller bottle) spread across a 4' x 4' area. For bear bait sites, use 3 oz of beads for the longer release of scent and the liquids to create a trail in which they will get on their paws and create well distributed trail and expanded area of attraction. Read the Inside Archery article "A Bear Camp Story" to see how multiple different scents add to success!

questions.q: Can I combine scent beads with liquid scent?
questions.a: Yes—this is the optimal approach. Deploy beads at your primary attraction point for 30-day continuous scent, then use liquid to create scent trails leading to the bead site and to treat licking branches, tree trunks, and travel routes. The two formats complement each other: beads provide sustained base attraction while liquid at specific contact points provide targeted, high-intensity scent that are carried through the air.

questions.q: Do I need to remove old beads before adding new ones?
questions.a: No. Odin's beads are biodegradable and will naturally decompose after the scent is exhausted. Simply add fresh beads on top of old ones when refreshing.

questions.q: What is the best deer attractant for trail cameras?
questions.a: The best trail camera attractant draws deer consistently over an extended period without requiring frequent replenishment visits that will reintroduce your human scent. Odin's food scent beads release scent for 30+ days from a single deployment, giving you a full month of trail camera data from one visit. The liquid is good for creating a trail toward the camera and for squirting on foliage to let the wind carry a stronger scent. This approach also minimizes human scent disturbance at your camera site.
